agent_runs.notes: Updated `model.fr` in place: replaced the undeclared component-only class setup with FeynRules classes for the fields actually used in the Lagrangian (`S1`, `S1t`, `R2`, `R2t`, `S3`) while preserving particle names, charges/hypercharges, masses, widths, and quantum numbers; removed invalid `HC[...]` placeholders by splitting non-Hermitian interaction blocks into `core + HC[core]`; replaced malformed/undefined quartic shorthand aliases with explicit invariant contractions using the declared fields and existing parameters; and changed the final top-level assignment to the required `LTot := LQ2Phi + LQkin + LQf + LQ3Phi + LQ4Phi;`. I also removed the undefined `LBSM` final symbol so the validation harness can find the BSM Lagrangian under `LTot`.

Updated `model.fr` in place by adding explicit `Value` entries for the indexed internal mixing/Yukawa parameters, using identity matrices for the unitary `W*mat` parameters and `1.0` entries for the Yukawa matrices, so UFO export has concrete parameter definitions; I also removed eager `ExpandIndices[..., FlavorExpand -> ...]` wrappers from the BSM Lagrangian pieces and combined duplicate quartic scalar operators into summed coefficients, preserving the same fields, couplings, terms, and `LTot` structure while avoiding the reported FeynRules compile-time blowup.

Updated `model.fr` in place by replacing direct BSM use of the unresolved SM Higgs doublet symbols `Phi`/`Phibar` with explicit component helpers built from `GP`, `G0`, `H`, and `vev`, so those names no longer leak into UFO particle export. I also rewrote the `Y33` adjoint scalar term as `core + HC[core]` with the same normalization, making its Hermiticity manifest to FeynRules while preserving the operator. `LTot` remains the final top-level assignment. I could not run the full Wolfram validation here because `wolframscript` has no configured kernel path in this environment.
